title: Signoff decisions file
description: A list of decisions for a person to make on a local page. All text is plain text; line breaks are kept, nothing is rendered as HTML or Markdown.

tab.description: A short label for this round's tab when a folder of rounds is served. Default: the title.

intro.description: One or two sentences under the heading.

notice.description: A short notice shown as a banner under the header, e.g. "Synthetic data only".

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag of the content, e.g. "en" or "de". Default "en".

free_text.description: The free-text box at the end of the page. It is always shown; this only names it.

id.description: Unique and stable: the answers are keyed by it.

group.description: A heading is shown whenever this changes from the item before.

cost.description: What it costs: effort, lines, tokens, money, risk.

options.description: At least two when select is "one".

recommended.description: Preselected and labelled. An option id for "one", a list of option ids for "many".

comment.description: Show a comment box under the options.

other.description: Add an "Other" choice with its own text field. It is recorded as the choice "_other", with the text in "other".

skippable.description: Add a "Skip" choice. It is recorded as the choice "_skip", on its own.

marks.description: Let the user draw rectangles on this item's pictures, each with a comment. They are recorded in the answer's "marks".

sensitive.description: The answer may hold personal data: the item starts marked Private. It only acts on an item with a text field (comment, other or marks). The user can untick it, or tick it on any item. A private answer is recorded with "private": true; its text stays in the answers file, and the Markdown copy hides its comment, Other text and mark comments.

criteria.description: What the options are compared on, in row order. With it, each option's facts show as chips on its card, and a Cards / Table toggle shows the options side by side, a row per criterion. The choice is the same in both views; the view is not saved.

attachments.description: Text files read when Signoff starts and shown under the options, each in a collapsed box as plain text: nothing in them is rendered. The Markdown copy names them only. Not changed by sensitive: the text is yours, not the user's.

src.description: Path relative to the decisions file, inside its folder (links are followed): a .md or .txt file, UTF-8, up to 256 KiB. A round's attachments together: up to 2 MiB as they go into the page, where <, > and & take 6 bytes each. No drive, network or absolute path. The page shows this name.

id.description: Unique within the item; the options' facts are keyed by it.

tone.description: How the value compares: shown as ▲ (good), ● (mid) or ▼ (bad) beside the text, and in colour; never colour alone.

image.description: A picture (src) or a board (html): exactly one of the two.

src.description: Path relative to the decisions file. It must stay inside that folder. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; no SVG.

html.description: A board: one self-contained HTML file relative to the decisions file, inside its folder, up to 2 MiB. Inline CSS and JS, data: images; nothing loads from outside, and it must hold nothing secret. It runs sandboxed and reads ?theme=light or ?theme=dark from its URL.

alt.description: Text for screen readers. Default: the caption, else the item title.

boxes.description: Highlight boxes as [x, y, w, h] in percent of the image, the meaning of W3C Media Fragments xywh=percent.

detail.description: A short line under the label.

facts.description: This option's value on the item's criteria, keyed by criterion id. Only the item's own criteria; a criterion left out shows as a dash in the table.
